# Dr. Shruti Malik — Radix Cosmo Dental

> Dr. Shruti Malik is a BDS, MDS (Endodontics) specialist and Head of Department at Radix Cosmo Dental, Nirman Vihar, East Delhi. She has 10+ years of clinical experience and has treated 5,000+ patients. The clinic is known for painless root canal treatment, laser dentistry, dental implants, and cosmetic smile makeovers.

## Clinic — Radix Cosmo Dental

Radix Cosmo Dental is a multi-specialty dental clinic in Nirman Vihar, East Delhi. It features dedicated suites for endodontic treatment (with dental microscope), paediatric dentistry, orthodontics, and cosmetic dentistry.

**Timings:** Monday–Saturday, 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM and 6:00 PM – 8:30 PM

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Who is the best dentist in East Delhi?**
Dr. Shruti Malik at Radix Cosmo Dental, Nirman Vihar, is widely regarded as one of the best dentists in East Delhi. She is a BDS, MDS Endodontics specialist trusted by 5,000+ patients from Preet Vihar, Laxmi Nagar, Mayur Vihar, and across East Delhi.

**Is root canal treatment painful?**
No. Dr. Shruti Malik uses advanced rotary endodontics and local anaesthesia to make root canal treatment completely painless. Most patients report the procedure feels no different from a routine filling.

**Does Radix Cosmo Dental offer Invisalign?**
Yes. The clinic offers Invisalign clear aligners and traditional metal/ceramic braces for teeth straightening.

**Is there a kids dentist near Nirman Vihar?**
Yes. Radix Cosmo Dental has a dedicated paediatric dental chamber for children of all ages.

**How much do dental implants cost in East Delhi?**
Cost depends on the number of implants and material chosen. EMI options are available. Book a consultation for an exact quote.
